There's something happening with post-training! People are starting to realize you can post-train open-source model to frontier on your tasks and constraints at a fraction of the cost of generalist black-box APIs. Let's go!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet clem 🤗 megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: White Circle (@whitecircle); megjelent: 2026-11-27T14:05:58+00:00; link: https://x.com/whitecircle/status/2126316605621555603; média: videó, 42 másodperc]
Excited to announce that @huggingface is joining the largest post-training competition ever!

Sign up now at https://whitecircle.com/halo/competition

Hugging Face is bringing two tracks to the competition:
- Improve Halo's integration with the Hugging Face ecosystem: https://github.com/whitecircle/halo
- Showcase the best model you can post-train

Details:
- Tracks from 13 leading AI companies
- $1.5m in compute for participants
- $200k+ in cash prizes
- Join solo or in a team of up to four
- Online, worldwide, Dec 1–10

Can't wait to see what you build!
